summary: Frontend-only testing of Haul Yeah Quality & Compliance module (prompt 1/3). Verified role-based routing, nav rendering, page testids, NC form validation, Documents form (Drive URL only, no file upload), Quote Accuracy filter inputs, and RBAC redirects for sales/crew. Airtable-missing 503s and empty-state banners are expected and not reported as bugs.

issues: From/To use native browser date pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than a shadcn/design-system Calendar component. Minor UX inconsistency.

critical_code_review_comments: Quote Accuracy: consider replacing native <input type=date> with the shared Calendar component for visual consistency with the rest of the CRM.

Feedback log section in /quality/quote-accuracy is not visually distinguishable in the Airtable-missing empty state; consider always rendering the section header (e.g., 'Per-job feedback') even when data is empty so users understand it exists.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Quality module fully functional on frontend. Test results per scenario: (1) Quality login lands on /quality/audits; left nav shows QUALITY group with Job Audits/Nonconformances/Documents/Quote Accuracy; footer shows 'Quality account' - PASS. (2) All 4 pages render with correct data-testids (quality-audits-page, quality-problems-page, quality-documents-page, quality-quote-accuracy-page) and the graceful 'Airtable key is not set' empty-state banner - PASS. (3) On /quality/problems, 'Raise one' opens nc-form-modal; selecting Status=Closed shows nc-close-hint; Save with empty root cause/corrective keeps modal open and shows validation text - PASS. (4) On /quality/documents, Add document opens doc-form-modal with doc-drive-input and NO file upload control - PASS. (5) /quality/quote-accuracy renders qa-from-input, qa-to-input, qa-rep-select - PASS. (6) Owner login (HaulYeahAdmin) sees QUALITY nav group and all four /quality/* routes render their pages - PASS. (7) Sales ghost lands on /leads, no 'Job Audits' in nav, direct visit to /quality/audits redirects to /leads, no quality page rendered - PASS. Crew ghost lands on /today, no 'Job Audits' in nav, direct visit to /quality/audits redirects to /today, no quality page rendered - PASS. Console shows expected 503s for Airtable-backed endpoints, no JS crashes. Minor design nit: native HTML date pickers on quote-accuracy page instead of shadcn Calendar.
